newsitem.title: USA: Valero sees late '96 work at Texas refinery.
newsitem.headline: Valero sees late '96 work at Texas refinery.

text.p: Valero Energy Corp on Wednesday said it will shut "late this year" a hydrocracker/reformer complex at its 170,000 barrel per day refinery in Corpus Christi, Texas, for planned maintenance.
"We are going to do a turnaround on our hydrocracker/ reformer complex toward the end of this year or early next year," a Valero spokesman said.
Another spokesman meanwhile said the maintenance would begin in December.
The complex houses two units, a hydrocracker and a naphtha reformer, each producing about 36,000 barrels a day. Both units are expected to be shut for "about three weeks," he said.
They added that no turnarounds were in progress at the refinery, nor were any others planned.
-- Franklin Paul, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1620
